CURRENT SCENE:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

ITEMS:

[I74] 【古代时候】   correction: 古代时候 → 古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代时候 -> 古代 (corrected 3/3 in train)
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]

[I75] 人不知道【他们】能吃什么植物   correction: 他们 → 自己   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: generic 人 more naturally refers back with 自己
  rule card (question_patterns, Grammar): Use 是……吗, V不V, or a Wh-question for an indirect question, not 如果. For “wh-ever…, will do that…”, repeat the Wh-word: 哪一筐……就……哪一筐.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this asks <whether/what/where>, so use <question pattern>, not 如果.  Her terms: repeated Wh-Q
  her past correction: 他们不知道什么植物[-能吃]不能吃
  her past correction: 我们不知道[-我们]可以吃什么植物 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 大家不知道什么[菜→植物]能吃

[I76] 【神农】出去试一试很多种植物   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 神农: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: 神农[加→吃]下去很多的植物
  her past correction: 神农[发现→发现了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看到很多人随便吃各种植物 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears

[I77] 神农出去【试一试】很多种植物   correction: 试一试 → 尝了   strength: error
  checker's note: plants are tasted to determine whether they are safe
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 神农[加→吃]下去很多的植物
  her past correction: 神农[什么想尝→想尝什么植物]
  her past correction: [神农旅行了，吃过新的植物→神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物] — her note: it is loosely connected with the previous sentence, better add “为了帮助人们找到能吃的植物”, 神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物，“过” is to express “experience”, now the experience has not yet been experienced

[I78] 告诉【人】什么植物是安全什么是危险   correction: 人 → 人们   strength: error
  checker's note: means telling people in general
  rule card (modifier_de_structure, Grammar): Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <modifier> describes the noun <noun>, so use 的; or <modifier> does not need 的 here, so omit it.  Her terms: no的
  her past correction: 每个人都不知道哪些植物能安全[+地]吃
  her past correction: [-他]写下了哪些植物有毒 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 让每个人都知道[什么植物能不能吃→什么植物能吃，什么植物不能吃]

[I79] 告诉人什么植物是安全【^】什么是危险   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: error
  checker's note: 是安全的 needs 的 before the following phrase
  rule card (modifier_de_structure, Grammar): Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <modifier> describes the noun <noun>, so use 的; or <modifier> does not need 的 here, so omit it.  Her terms: no的
  her past correction: 每个人都不知道哪些植物能安全[+地]吃
  her past correction: [-他]写下了哪些植物有毒 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]

[I80] 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险【^】   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: error
  checker's note: 是危险的 needs 的
  rule card (modifier_de_structure, Grammar): Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <modifier> describes the noun <noun>, so use 的; or <modifier> does not need 的 here, so omit it.  Her terms: no的
  her past correction: 每个人都不知道哪些植物能安全[+地]吃
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: [-他]写下了哪些植物有毒 — her note: redundant

items.explanation: 时候 is redundant because 古代 already expresses the time.
It would be more natural to use 自己 to refer back to generic 人.
神农 appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly with an identifying noun phrase.
试一试 does not normally collocate with plants in this situation; use 尝了 instead.
Use 人们 when you mean people in general.
安全 describes the omitted noun 植物, so use 的: 是安全的.
危险 describes the omitted noun 植物, so use 的: 是危险的.
